relevance.rationale: Establishes the Racah-Askey-Wilson closed-form formula, tetrahedral symmetry, and ribbon framing phases for U_q(sl_2) quantum 6j-symbols.

keyResults.statement: Closed-form q-factorial sum for U_q(sl_2) quantum 6j-symbols satisfying Biedenharn-Elliott pentagon and orthogonal recoupling identities.
keyResults.useForFolio: Evaluated at 85 dps on the real proton pin q_0^{(p)} across tetrahedral K_4 spins j = 1/2, 1, 3/2 in computations/probes/untapped_algebraic_invariants_proton_probe.py.
